statements.impact_statement: apt only comes with the base image and never runs: the Dockerfile installs with pip, and the app runs gunicorn as a non-root user.

The flaw is in the gz* file functions of zlib (gz_write, used by gzwrite and gzprintf). zlib1g comes with the base image, and the app only reaches zlib through the Python zlib module, which uses the deflate/inflate stream functions and never calls the gz* functions. Temporary: remove when the official python base image ships zlib1g 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+deb13u1 (DSA-6613-1).
